title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo a las Reformas de los Sectores de Agua, Saneamiento y Energa II
Support Program for Reforms in the Water, Sanitation and Energy Sectors II

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a mejorar y aumentar el acceso a los servicios de agua, saneamiento y electricidad en el pas a travs del proceso de consolidacin de reformas destinado a mejorar la gobernanza del sector y la gestin de los servicios. El objetivo especfico es apoyar el desarrollo de medidas de poltica incluidas en la matriz de polticas de la operacin.

The general objective of the Program is to contribute to improving and increasing the access to water, sanitation, and electricity services in the country through the reform consolidation process aimed at improving sector governance and service management. The specific objective is to support the development of policy measures included in the policy matrix of the future operation.
Commitment in 2020-12-09
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2020
